svg.title: Indoor vertical / aeroponic room — Mist delivery & liquid return
svg.desc: Mist delivery & liquid return. 7 equipment references and 8 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
